title: Never Share Your OTP
summary: Bank staff, police, and lottery agents will NEVER ask for your OTP. Sharing an OTP gives complete access to empty your bank account.
rule: Rule: If someone asks for OTP on phone or SMS, immediately disconnect and report.

title: Keep ATM PIN Secret
summary: Never write your ATM PIN on the back of your card or tell it to shopkeepers. Cover the keypad with your hand when withdrawing cash.
rule: Rule: Only enter ATM PIN on official bank cash machines.

title: PIN is Only for Sending Money
summary: You NEVER need to enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE money or claim cashbacks/lotteries. Entering your PIN always deducts money from your account.
rule: Golden Rule: Enter PIN = Money OUT. Receiving money requires NO PIN.

title: Scanning QR Does Not Credit Money
summary: Scammers send QR codes claiming 'Scan this to receive prize/government subsidy'. Scanning a QR code only pays out money.
rule: Rule: Never scan a QR code sent by an unknown person to receive funds.

title: No Police or CBI Conducts Video Arrests
summary: Fraudsters pose as CBI, Police, or Customs over Skype/WhatsApp video calls, claiming illegal parcels were found in your name and threatening 'digital arrest'.
rule: Truth: Indian Law has NO provision for 'Digital Arrest'. Real police never demand online fines or secret settlements.

title: Beware of 'SIM/Bank Blocking' Alerts
summary: Fraudulent SMS or callers say 'Your SIM/Bank account will be blocked in 2 hours. Install QuickSupport or AnyDesk app for instant KYC'.
rule: Rule: Never install screen-sharing apps on caller instructions. Always visit your bank branch directly.
